## Expert Lecture on “Explainable AI”

News Date : 07 Nov 2025News ReportTheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with theDepartment of Information Technology, organized anExpert Lectureon07 November 2025as part of its IIPC activities.The session featuredDr. K.V.S.N. Rama Rao,Tenured Leader, Brane Enterprises, Hyderabad, who delivered an engaging talk on the topic“Explainable AI.”The event witnessed active participation from students and faculty members of the Institute.In his address,Dr. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy, Principal, encouraged students to explore cutting-edge technologies and create innovative opportunities in the field of Artificial Intelligence.Dr. D. Vijaya Lakshmi, Head of the Department, IT, highlighted the growing necessity of Artificial Intelligence knowledge for students of IT and CSB disciplines.During the lecture,Dr. K.V.S.N. Rama Raoexplained thatExplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)comprises methods and techniques that make AI systems’ decision-making processes transparent, understandable, and interpretable to humans. He emphasized that XAI is essential for buildingtrust and accountabilityin critical domains such ashealthcare, finance, law, and defense, where opaque “black-box” models are unsuitable without clear justification. The speaker also elaborated on theethical and legal complianceaspects of XAI in modern AI applications.The session was summarized byDr. N. Sree Divya,Co-Convenor, IIPC, and concluded with avote of thanksdelivered byDr. P. Chandra Sekhar,Convenor, IIPC.

TheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with theDepartment of Information Technology, organized anExpert Lectureon07 November 2025as part of its IIPC activities.
The session featuredDr. K.V.S.N. Rama Rao,Tenured Leader, Brane Enterprises, Hyderabad, who delivered an engaging talk on the topic“Explainable AI.”The event witnessed active participation from students and faculty members of the Institute.
In his address,Dr. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy, Principal, encouraged students to explore cutting-edge technologies and create innovative opportunities in the field of Artificial Intelligence.Dr. D. Vijaya Lakshmi, Head of the Department, IT, highlighted the growing necessity of Artificial Intelligence knowledge for students of IT and CSB disciplines.
During the lecture,Dr. K.V.S.N. Rama Raoexplained thatExplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)comprises methods and techniques that make AI systems’ decision-making processes transparent, understandable, and interpretable to humans. He emphasized that XAI is essential for buildingtrust and accountabilityin critical domains such ashealthcare, finance, law, and defense, where opaque “black-box” models are unsuitable without clear justification. The speaker also elaborated on theethical and legal complianceaspects of XAI in modern AI applications.
The session was summarized byDr. N. Sree Divya,Co-Convenor, IIPC, and concluded with avote of thanksdelivered byDr. P. Chandra Sekhar,Convenor, IIPC.
